for p in \

  "/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/js/pako.esm.js" \
  "/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/js/lerc.js" \

  "/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/js/DrawModule.js" \
  "/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/js/three.core.js" \
  "/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/js/vuetify.js" \
  "/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/js/bootstrap-icons.woff2" \
  "/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/locales/de/common.json" \
  "/examples/Basic/resources/img/mp_logo.png" ; do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost$p"); size=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{size_download}" "http://localhost$p"); echo "$code  ${size}B  $p";
